import os,shutil
home=os.environ['HOME']
os.chdir(home)
t=home+'/text/dropkey/'
if os.path.exists(f'{swap}/id_rsa'):
    if not os.path.exists(t):
        os.mkdir(t)
    for i in '','.pub':
        shutil.copy(f'{swap}/id_rsa{i}',f'{t}/id_rsa{i}')
    i=home+'/.ssh/known_hosts'
    if os.path.exists(i):
        os.remove(i)
t = f"/system/bin/linker64 {home}/bin/dropbearmulti ssh -p {port} -i '{t}/id_rsa' -t localhost 'cd && echo $HOME && {cmd} $@'"
os.system(t)
shutil.rmtree('{swap}')
